title: Arrival Notifications
body: The arrival notifications are a thoughtful feature. I can set up familiar places and get an alert when someone reaches their destination, which saves me from repeatedly checking my phone.

title: Coordinate Sharing
body: This is certainly a great app. What stands out to me is the option to send an SOS with my coordinates. Hopefully I won’t need it, but knowing there’s a quick way to alert trusted contacts is reassuring.

title: Place Alerts
body: This app makes sharing locations feel more organized. I can see updates from the people who have agreed to share with me, while the place alerts help me keep track of important arrivals and departures.

title: Safety Features
body: A practical tool for families and groups of friends. Between route sharing, location updates, and emergency alerts, it brings several useful safety features together instead of needing different apps.

title: Coordinate Plans
body: I like being able to coordinate plans without constantly texting everyone for updates. Sharing a live location makes meeting up much easier, especially when plans change along the way.
